### Fixed

- (app) [Background Kubernetes reads never open Login Required](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3102) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — After the portal sign-in expired, Agent Platform pages that poll Kubernetes no longer open the `Login Required` dialog by themselves, on installations whose Kubernetes access uses the portal sign-in. It opens only when you act.
- (backend) [Serialize the replicas' first migrations on PostgreSQL](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3093) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — For operators: a fresh install with `database.engine: postgresql` and two or more replicas starts without a restart per pod. The backends run their first database migrations one after another, logging `Waiting for another backend's migrations of …`.
- (gs) [A background cluster-token mint never opens Login Required](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3111) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — After the portal sign-in expired, background cluster access checks no longer open the `Login Required` dialog by themselves. Cluster access shows that the session expired, with `Sign in again`.
- (ui-react) [Footnote links and ids share one user-content- prefix](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3116) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — In markdown such as Hive's documents and plans, a footnote reference jumps to its note, and the note's back-link, read as `Back to content`, jumps back.

### Development and CI/CD

- (ci) [Print tsc and lint output after jest in the Verify step](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3112) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — The CI Verify step prints type-check and lint errors after the test output, so CircleCI's truncated log no longer cuts them off.
- (deps) [Update assistant-ui packages](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3089) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.9.1...v3.9.2
